login_auth.description: User authentication, credential handling, account registration, and access barriers.
login_auth.inclusion_rules: Matches login, sign-in, credential entry, account verification, and session timeouts.
login_auth.exclusion_and_ambiguity_notes: 'akun' is paired with access/registration context to avoid false positives with accounting chart of accounts (nama akun kas).

crash_stability.description: Application crashes, freezing, sudden closures, performance latency, and system bugs.
crash_stability.inclusion_rules: Matches unexpected application shutdown, hanging screens, persistent error dialogues, and UI freezes.
crash_stability.exclusion_and_ambiguity_notes: 'error' is matched in system failure context. 'close' is matched via 'force close' or 'close sendiri' to avoid confusing with accounting period closing (tutup buku).

pricing_subscription.description: Software monetization, subscription tiers, renewal fees, trial limitations, and licensing costs.
pricing_subscription.inclusion_rules: Matches discussions of software cost, subscription requirements, paid versus free versions, and license expiration.
pricing_subscription.exclusion_and_ambiguity_notes: 'bayar' in POS retail transactions is distinguished where possible; rule targets software access payments and subscription tiers.

sync_cloud_data.description: Multi-device cloud synchronization, database connection, server downtime, and stored data loss.
sync_cloud_data.inclusion_rules: Matches cloud database connectivity, sync failure between mobile and web/desktop, and data disappearance.
sync_cloud_data.exclusion_and_ambiguity_notes: 'data' is required to appear alongside sync, storage, or loss predicates to avoid capturing general data entry.

pos_hardware_print.description: Point-of-Sale hardware peripherals, Bluetooth thermal printers, receipt layout, barcode, and cash drawers.
pos_hardware_print.inclusion_rules: Matches hardware peripheral integration, thermal paper printing, Bluetooth printer pairing, and retail cash register functions.
pos_hardware_print.exclusion_and_ambiguity_notes: 'pos' is matched with word boundary to avoid substrings in words like 'posisi'.

inventory_accounting.description: Bookkeeping features, stock management, financial reports, transaction recording, and invoicing.
inventory_accounting.inclusion_rules: Matches core accounting transactions, ledger management, inventory tracking, financial statements, and invoice processing.
inventory_accounting.exclusion_and_ambiguity_notes: 'po' matches Purchase Order context; 'laporan' matches financial and transactional reports.

certification_exam.description: Zahir Certification app functionality: exam sessions, question navigation, scoring, and certificate issuance.
certification_exam.inclusion_rules: Matches student/professional certification test sessions, test questions, grading, and digital certificate delivery.
certification_exam.exclusion_and_ambiguity_notes: 'nilai' is matched in examination grading context rather than financial asset valuation.

attendance_face.description: Zahir Attendance app workflows: facial biometric scanning, GPS location verification, and attendance check-in/out.
attendance_face.inclusion_rules: Matches employee attendance clocking, selfie photo capture, facial detection accuracy, and GPS location radius.
attendance_face.exclusion_and_ambiguity_notes: 'lokasi' and 'foto' are paired with attendance and selfie validation context.
